title: begin_application Input
description: Input schema for the begin_application tool.

apply_path.description: Preferred application mechanism. If omitted, the provider selects the optimal path.

referrer.description: The source that referred the candidate (e.g., domain name, platform identifier).

reference_id.description: Opaque token the source can use for reconciliation (e.g., click ID, session ID).

attribution_ref.description: An attribution_ref previously returned by this provider for the job being applied to. Agents that apply under the same identity that received the job need not relay it. See spec § Attribution.
